privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Learn how we protect your personal information.
privacy.intro: LOPEZSOFT SAS (hereinafter "the Company"), based in Dosquebradas, Risaralda, Colombia, is committed to protecting the privacy of its users. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, store and protect your personal information when you use our services and visit our website.

collection.title: Information We Collect
collection.text: We collect information that you provide directly to us when using our services, including:
items: Full name and contact details (email, phone number)
Data necessary for service delivery (tax ID, business name)
Technical browsing information (cookies, IP address, browser type)

use.title: Use of Information
use.text: We use your personal information for the following purposes:
items: Provide and improve our technology services
Process contact requests and provide technical support
Send relevant communications about product updates
Comply with legal and regulatory obligations
Ensure the security of our platforms

cookies.title: Cookies and Tracking Technologies
cookies.text: Our website uses essential cookies for proper functionality, such as theme preference (light/dark) and selected language. We do not use advertising tracking cookies nor share data with third-party advertising networks.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.text: In accordance with Colombian law, you have the right to:
items: Know, update and rectify your personal data
Request proof of the authorization granted
Be informed about the use of your data
Revoke authorization and/or request data deletion
File complaints with the Superintendency of Industry and Commerce

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: To exercise your rights or make inquiries about this policy, you can contact us at gerencia@lopezsoft.net.co or by calling +57 310 843 5431.

data_protection.title: Personal Data Protection
data_protection.subtitle: Personal data processing policy in accordance with Law 1581 of 2012.
data_protection.intro: In compliance with Statutory Law 1581 of 2012 and its Regulatory Decree 1377 of 2013, LOPEZSOFT SAS adopts this Personal Data Processing Policy to guarantee the constitutional right of all individuals to know, update and rectify the information collected about them.

responsible.title: Data Controller
responsible.text: LOPEZSOFT SAS, a Colombian commercial company, is responsible for processing the personal data it collects in the course of its activities.

principles.title: Guiding Principles
principles.text: Personal data processing is governed by the following principles:
items: Legality: processing is subject to current legal provisions
Purpose: processing serves a legitimate purpose
Freedom: data can only be processed with prior, express and informed consent
Accuracy: information subject to processing must be truthful, complete and up-to-date
Transparency: the right to obtain information about personal data is guaranteed
Security: information is handled with necessary technical and administrative measures
Confidentiality: all persons involved in processing must guarantee information confidentiality

treatment.title: Processing Purposes
treatment.text: Personal data is processed for the following purposes:
items: Execute contractual relationships with clients and suppliers
Carry out electronic invoicing and tax compliance activities
Provide technical support and customer service
Send information about products, services and updates
Comply with legal obligations before control entities (DIAN, SIC)

rights.title: Data Subject Rights
rights.text: Personal data subjects have the following rights:
items: Access provided data free of charge
Know, update and rectify personal data
File complaints with the SIC for legal violations
Revoke authorization and/or request data deletion
Access personal data processed free of charge

security.title: Security Measures
security.text: LOPEZSOFT SAS implements technical, human and administrative measures to ensure the security of personal data, preventing its alteration, loss, consultation, unauthorized or fraudulent use or access.

contact.title: Support Channels
contact.text: To exercise the aforementioned rights or make inquiries and claims, you can contact us at gerencia@lopezsoft.net.co or by calling +57 310 843 5431.
